hypothesis: The unchanged balanced-base student can retain teacher elites in a superset cheaply enough to support teacher-verified CEM updates.

student.checkpoint_policy: load exact saved checkpoint if present; otherwise reconstruct once with original balanced bank, initialization, schedule, objective and 3000 updates; label reconstructed and save on compute node

stage_a.candidate_contract: same logged-action Gaussian bank and official objective as temporal-balanced evaluation
stage_a.replicate: episode; anchors and candidate seeds nested
stage_a.selection_rule: smallest K passing every gate; no K passes means stop

timing.latency_gate_aggregation: median of paired per-block latency reductions
timing.boundary: cached latent to selected elite indices: rollout, official cost, sorting/gathering and teacher verification; exclude encoder and environment

stage_b.shadow_teacher: diagnostic only; never used by student or unverified hybrid candidates; excluded from production timing
stage_b.implementation_rule: implement and preflight only after Stage A passes; no outcome-dependent changes to frozen endpoints or thresholds

execution.usage_reset_stop: stop agent work immediately if main codex usedPercent falls from observed 70 or higher to 0; base_model_inference reserve already starts at 0 and is not the trigger
